answer.exemplar: A prop is tested because it has to work at the moment the plot needs it, and the rehearsal floor is where that truth comes out. answer.exemplar: A repeated convention gradually becomes invisible, and that is what has happened here: the audience no longer reads the slow dim as a signal to settle. stimulus.body: A short reference note on a costume note and what it signals is set for a close-reading task. It states: A costume note records what the garment will suggest to the audience, so an oversized coat becomes a stated reading rather than an accident of fit. answer.exemplar: A costume note describes the garment as the audience will meet it, and an oversized oilskin tells them something before a word is spoken: that the wearer is larger than the role requires, that the coat was chosen for weather or haste, or that the character is being swallowed by the work. questions.explanation: A costume note records what the garment will suggest to the audience, so an oversized coat becomes a stated reading rather than an accident of fit. It protects the intent from being lost.
